difficulty_rationale: Level 5 (required abstention, P0): every site touching the two rename targets sits behind one of four unsafe-to-automate constructs (dynamic dispatch, reflection, string-concatenated member access, shadowed local bindings). There is no safe site, so the only correct output is a global abstention with four reason codes. Any edit is a broken migration.

notes: Abstention-by-absence and reasoned-abstention agree on the observable outcome: no edit anywhere. A reasoned engine must emit the four reason codes.
